Goal: UI imprveoments

Work wth Claude-Code-Design-MCP to inpect areas of the application starting with EPICs, Scheduler for improvements

Renders clean, no layout breaks. Design work is done: https://claude.ai/design/p/69b38760-b010-45b6-8885-1e1e9a11833a?file=Epics+%2B+Scheduler+UI+improvements.dc.html

**What I did:** Read the actual Epics component tree (`EpicsWorkspace`, `EpicQueue`, `EpicDetail`, `NewEpicCard`, `epic-primitives.tsx`, `agentTagDefs.ts`) and Scheduler (`Scheduler.tsx`, `SchedulePanel.tsx`, `sched-primitives.tsx`) via a research agent, pulled the app's live Almanac palette straight from `tailwind.config.js`, then built 6 before/after mockups grounded in real file:line references rather than generic redesign slop:

**Epics (1a–1c):**
- 1a — collapse the two competing chip idioms (outline kind-tag vs filled status-chip) into one pill family
- 1b — surface `agentTagDefs.ts`'s already-written `description` field as a hover tooltip on the type picker (currently dead data)
- 1c — regroup `EpicDetail`'s flat 6-item meta row into Timeline / Activity / Session, and give the copy-session-id action real button affordance instead of looking like static text

**Scheduler (2a–2c):**
- 2a — collapse the 6 stacked full-width banners above the job table into one status rail + inline policy controls, and add skeleton rows for `SchedulePanel.tsx:180`'s bare `return null` loading state
- 2b — unify `SchBadge` and `PrdStatusPill` (two status vocabularies that render "completed" in different colors on the same page) into one badge, and spell out the `p/r/d/f` count shorthand
- 2c — give "Clear queue" (a real archive action, currently a plain text link) danger-button weight to match its blast radius

This is a mockup deliverable only — no app code was touched. I didn't file a `/propose-epic` for implementing any of these since you said "inspect... for improvements," not "build" — say the word if you want any of 1a–2c turned into actual PRDs.

I need to fix the EPIC left-nav, does not fill in the full container

Attached: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/attachments/ktogygx3j5o-image.png

Typecheck passes clean. One-line fix: added `h-full` to the `<aside>` root in `src/renderer/components/epics/EpicQueue.tsx:266` — it's a `flex-col` child of `EpicsWorkspace.tsx:252`'s wrapper, and `align-items: stretch` only fills the cross axis, not a `flex-col` element's own vertical extent, so the panel (background, border, footer) was sizing to content and leaving blank space below it.

No further action needed — the hot-reloaded dev app should now show the queue panel's border/background extending full height. Not committed, since you didn't ask me to.
